sources.name: The Infatuation (Turkish)

quotes.Enfes Ocakbaşı: Get a sizzling mixed grill and load up fantastic free bread and salad at Enfes Ocakbaşı, a Turkish spot on Green Lanes.
quotes.Mangal II: Mangal II is a classic Turkish restaurant that's doing things a bit differently. With superb grilled meats, sourdough pide, natural wines, and more.
quotes.Durak Tantuni: Durak Tantuni is an all-day and late-night tantuni house in Harringay serving unrivalled dürüm wraps.
quotes.Kofteci Metin: Come to Kofteci Metin, a Turkish kofte specialist on Harringay's Green Lanes, for a meal of expertly grilled meatballs and deliciously dressed salads.
quotes.Mangal 1: A legendary institution just off the Dalston strip, Mangal 1 is a BYOB Turkish spot with an always-lively atmosphere.
quotes.Umut 2000: Umut 2000 is a classic ocakbasi restaurant just off of the Kingsland Road. Come for the grilled meat and lamb ribs. Stay for the excellent staff.
quotes.Diyarbakır Kitchen: Diyarbakir Kitchen is a reliable all-round ocakbasi restaurant in Harringay, ideal for when you're in a big group, all hungry for perfectly grilled and spiced kofte.
quotes.Antepliler Doner: Antepliler Doner is a restaurant and takeaway spot in Harringay specialising in tender and juicy homemade döner kebabs that are often drenched in butter.
quotes.Gökyüzü Restaurant: Gökyüzü is an all-day, late-night Turkish spot in Harringay. It's a Green Lanes landmark and one of our favourite spots in London.
quotes.Haringey Corbacisi: Haringey Corbacisi on Green Lanes is a no-menu restaurant that specialises in soups and stews, perfect for a solo pick-me-up or late-night sustenance.
quotes.Ustun Lahmacun & Pide Salonu: Go to Ustun Lahmacun & Pide Salonu by Newington Green for a freshly made, crispy lahmacun and a quiet sit-down.
quotes.The Mantl: The Mantl serves good Turkish dishes like manti, adana, and sarma beyti in Knightsbridge.
quotes.Antepliler Künefe & Patisserie: Antepliler Künefe & Patisserie on Green Lanes serves some of London's best künefe in a warm and inviting dining room that's as perfect for a one-to-one as it is a late-night group dessert run.
quotes.The Counter: A modern Turkish spot in Notting Hill, The Counter is making fun food in a moody dining room.
quotes.FM Mangal: FM Mangal is a casual Turkish restaurant in Camberwell serving up tasty kofte and bread you'll devour multiple bowls of.
quotes.Güneş Restaurant: Güneş Restaurant is an Anatolian and Mediterranean spot in Walthamstow that does unthinkably delicious things with meat.
quotes.The Best Turkish Kebab: The Best Turkish Kebab is an excellent Stoke Newington spot for well-stuffed Turkish wraps and celeb-spotting on their wall of famous fans.
quotes.Ishtar: Turkish spot Ishtar in Marylebone is great for meals that fall on the more casual end of the special occasion spectrum.

sources.note: Verdicts recorded 2026-08-30 from the page JSON-LD. Two street addresses and a byline are interposed as name fields and were dropped.
